- eligible = participantUnits (profile threads model.recall.ordered.size)
- observed = units with ≥ 1 assessment

- 2-arg overload keeps eligible = observed so the reserved InterviewSuite still compiles
- empty assessments + participantUnits=N → Coverage(N, 0) + Missing rates
- law: discourse-only units lower coverage and leave both rates unchanged
